answer: Through the vault, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. Answers carry a bond that is slashed when peers grade them as junk, and the bond grows after each offence. Through the comet, mass-produced answers become mass-produced losses — the farm's thousand submissions each risk a forfeit, while one honest answer risks almost nothing. Past the reef, an honest agent's single payment buys a seat, while a clone farm's bill grows with every identity it mints.
